title: Generative Perturbation Analysis for Probabilistic Black-Box Anomaly Attribution

problem.claim: The task is to compute the probability distribution of each input variable's attribution score for an observed anomaly in black-box regression.

gap.claim: The task explains anomalous deviation from a black-box prediction rather than the black-box model itself, distinguishing it from standard XAI.

narrative_sequence.summary: Defines probabilistic anomaly attribution for black-box regression.
Assumes the training dataset is unavailable.
Contrasts anomaly-deviation explanation with explaining the black-box model itself.
